criteria.requirement: Eight complete bundled recipes have readable ingredients/steps and a 3D kitchen counter whose ingredient models track the selected recipe.
criteria.action: Open each of the eight sample recipes and inspect counter, ingredients and steps.
criteria.expected: Complete local recipe content is readable and the 3D ingredient arrangement matches the chosen recipe.

criteria.requirement: Search matches names/ingredients; vegetarian/time filters, empty results and reset work consistently.
criteria.action: Search names/ingredients, combine vegetarian/time filters, produce empty results and reset.
criteria.expected: Results respect all active filters, an empty state is clear and reset restores recipes.

criteria.requirement: Serving changes scale ingredient quantities with useful units and fractions.
criteria.action: Change serving counts for recipes with fractional quantities.
criteria.expected: Ingredient quantities scale consistently with useful units and fractions.

criteria.requirement: Stable recipe URLs survive refresh, with correct recipe content.
criteria.action: Open a recipe URL directly and refresh.
criteria.expected: The same recipe and complete content are restored.

criteria.requirement: Cooking view has previous/next steps and ingredient checkboxes; progress is stored separately per recipe across refresh.
criteria.action: Check ingredients and change steps, switch recipes and refresh.
criteria.expected: Previous/next works and each recipe's checked ingredients and step persist separately.

criteria.requirement: Resetting one recipe does not mix its progress with another; ingredient names and mobile cooking remain usable outside the canvas.
criteria.action: Reset one recipe, revisit another and use a narrow phone layout.
criteria.expected: Only the selected recipe resets; ingredient names remain available outside the canvas and cooking needs no camera manipulation.

scenarios.instruction: Inspect recipes, ingredient list and linked 3D counter.
Search by ingredient, combine filters, adjust servings and advance cooking steps while checking ingredients.
Refresh, switch recipes and return to verify separated progress, exercise empty/reset states and reload a recipe URL.

Inspect a 390px-wide viewport, including lower controls and focus navigation. Perform the task through the primary UI without relying on precise 3D camera manipulation. Record any clipped, obstructed or unreachable content.
